In a round-robin tournament, 4 teams (Eagles, Falcons, Hawks, Kites) each played every other team exactly once (no draws). The results were:

- Falcons beat Eagles
- Hawks beat Eagles
- Kites beat Eagles
- Hawks beat Falcons
- Falcons beat Kites
- Hawks beat Kites

A win is worth 2 points, a loss 0. Study the results and answer the questions that follow.
